A completed, print-ready PDF

An editable Canva copy for future updates

This service includes customization of my existing 24-page design, including replacing text, photos, property details, and adjusting colours.

This is a made-to-order digital product. No physical item will be shipped.

All photos and property information must be supplied by the buyer.

Your finished Welcome Book is intended for use at your own rental property and may not be resold or redistributed as a template.

• An editable Canva welcome-book template with 30 guest-information pages: 20 core pages plus 10 additional pages.
• A separate illustration library page containing 15 additional images to swap into your book.
• A PDF containing the Canva template link and practical editing instructions.

01. Cover — add your property name.
02. Welcome & essentials — Wi-Fi, address, host contact and checkout details.
03. Your guide — contents and an overview of the book.
04. Arrival & access — check-in, directions, keys and entrance/access photos.

07. Safety & emergencies — property address, emergency contacts, safety equipment and exit information.

18. FAQs & troubleshooting — answers to common guest questions.
19. Before you go — checkout tasks, key return and locking up.

results.title: Airbnb Welcome Book Printable, Guest House Manual for Vacation Rental Hosts, Wifi, House Rules and Local Guide, 12 Page PDF
results.description:
Guests ask the same eight questions. Where do I park, how does the heat work, when is bin day, what is there to eat near here. This is where you answer them once, in your own handwriting, and leave it where they will actually find it.

Twelve pages. You fill in the first two as the host, and pages three to twelve are the book your guests read.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Start here, for the host, and a forty minute order to fill it in
• Before your first guest: what to print, what to stock, and what to reprint later
• Welcome: the note from you, wifi, check out time, and the people nearby
• Arriving and leaving: parking, the door, finding the place, and what to do before they go
• How the house works: heat, hot water, kitchen, laundry, TV, and well or tank water
• House rules, plainly, with the usual questions answered in a line each
• Bins, recycling, and the short list for before they leave
• If something goes wrong: shutoffs, the five problems that actually happen, and who to call
• Where we eat: your three, then everything else
• What to do nearby, within ten minutes and worth the drive
• The place by season, because guests arrive in February too
• Thank you, a guest book, and a page for what you changed

WHY THIS ONE IS SHORT
Most welcome books are thirty pages and read like a lease. Guests skim five. This one keeps the answers on the pages they'll reach for, in plain sentences, and the handwriting reads as a person rather than a policy.

ONE HABIT THROUGHOUT
Door codes and alarm codes go on the printed copy that stays inside the house, never in a listing, a photo, or a message thread. The book says so on the page where you'd be tempted.

WHAT IT WON'T DO
It explains how the house works. It is not a rental agreement, and nothing in it is legal or insurance advice. It is also not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to any booking platform.

PRINT IT OR FILL IT IN
A regular PDF with no fill-in form fields. Print at actual size, or type onto it with the free Fill & Sign tool in Adobe Acrobat Reader, the markup tools on an iPhone or iPad, or Preview on a Mac.

Shopping on your phone? Etsy's app can't download digital files yet. Open Etsy in your phone's web browser instead, sign in, and download from your Purchases page.

GOES WELL WITH
The Household Emergency Binder for the shutoffs and the call list, and The Sitter Sheet if someone looks after the place while you're away.

WHAT YOU GET
One PDF, 12 pages, US Letter. Instant download, nothing ships.

Warm off-white, charcoal and one deep green. It suits a city apartment, a cabin, or a family beach house.

results.description:
Instant WiFi access for your guests - one tap or scan and they're connected. No app, no typing, no hassle.

This handcrafted Baltic birch sign is laser-engraved with your property name and WiFi details, plus a pre-programmed NFC chip. Tap or scan -  both included, both ready to use.

★ WHY OURS
 Most WiFi signs only give a QR code. Ours adds NFC tap too, so it works on every phone - and your name (plus logo, if you'd like) makes it feel like part of the space, not an afterthought.

★ 2 SIZES & DIMENSIONS
🔹 SMALL — 9 × 12 cm 
Perfect for: Reception desks · Individual offices · Meeting room tables · Consultation rooms · Any space where one client is seen at a time

🔹 LARGE — 12 × 17 cm 
Perfect for: Office lobbies · Front desk counters · High-traffic entrances · Waiting areas · Any space that needs to be visible from across the room

Base: 9mm thick wooden stand, included

★ HOW TO ORDER
Just a few quick things we need from you:

1. Your property or business name
Type it into the Personalization box at checkout — this is what will be engraved at the top of the sign.

2. Your WiFi network name and password
Type the exact network name (SSID) and password into the Personalization box, spelled and cased exactly as they should appear - for example: "Network: OliveGuest / Password: welcomehome." Double-check this before submitting, since it's exactly what we'll engrave.

Please include:

WiFi Network Name (SSID)
Password
Security type (WPA2 / WPA3 / WEP / Open)
Hidden network? (Yes / No)

3. Your logo -  only if you've added the logo upgrade
Attach a high-resolution file (PNG, SVG, or JPG works best) as a photo in the Personalization box.

Before we cut anything, we double-check your name, WiFi details, and logo with you. If you'd like to see a preview before we go into production, just send us a message.

★ WHAT'S INCLUDED 
✔ Laser-engraved Baltic birch sign, standard size 
✔ Your property/business name, engraved 
✔ Your WiFi network & password, engraved 
✔ 9mm Baltic birch base, no tools needed

✔ Static QR code, laser-engraved — never fades 
✔ "TAP OR SCAN – to connect," engraved 
✔ Optional: your logo, engraved alongside your name

★ PLEASE NOTE ABOUT NFC & iPHONE

NFC WiFi functionality is different between iPhone and Android.

Android: Compatible devices can connect to WiFi automatically through NFC.

iPhone: iOS does not allow an NFC WiFi tag to directly join the network in the same way. Instead, our NFC tag opens a webpage containing your WiFi information, allowing guests to easily copy the password and paste it into their WiFi settings.

For iPhone users, we recommend using the QR code for the fastest connection.

The NFC feature is still fully functional on iPhone - it simply provides access to the WiFi information rather than automatically joining the network.

★ WHY BALTIC BIRCH 
Warmer and more premium than acrylic or plastic - real texture, real grain, no two signs alike.

results.title: Airbnb Guest Cards Template | Editable Canva Signs | WiFi, House Rules, Check-Out & More
results.description:
Your guests need information. Your walls don't need instructions.
The Guest Cards Collection turns Wi-Fi details, house guidelines, check-out information and everyday guest questions into beautifully written, editable Canva cards designed to belong in a considered Airbnb or short-term rental.

THE GUEST CARDS COLLECTION
Practical information, without turning your home into a rulebook.

Every host needs to communicate.
The Wi-Fi password.
Where to park.
What time quiet hours begin.
Where the extra towels are.
How check-out works.

But there is a difference between giving guests information and covering a beautiful rental in signs.
The Guest Cards Collection was created for hosts who want both.
Clear guidance for the guest.
A considered interior for everyone else.
A collection of beautifully designed, thoughtfully written guest cards that help practical information feel like part of the hospitality — not an interruption to it.
Gentle in tone. Clear in purpose.

YOUR HOUSE RULES SHOULDN'T FEEL LIKE RULES.
There is a reason handwritten notes, laminated warnings and giant "DO NOT" signs feel wrong inside an otherwise beautiful property.
They change the atmosphere.
Suddenly the guest is no longer being welcomed.
They are being managed.
The Guest Cards Collection takes the same practical information and gives it a different voice:
warm, concise, clear and human.
Instead of:
NO SHOES.
you can say:
"The floors are clean and the slippers are warm — both are for you. Leave your shoes by the door; your feet are off duty now."
Instead of a cold NO SMOKING sign:
"We keep the air linen-fresh for every guest who sleeps here. If you smoke — the balcony has the better view anyway."
The message still lands.
It just sounds like hospitality.

NOT SIGNS. PART OF THE STAY.
These cards are designed to do three things at once:
GUIDE — Put useful information exactly where the guest needs it.
WELCOME — Use language that feels warm rather than corrective.
BELONG — Make the card feel considered enough to live inside a styled interior.
That means the Wi-Fi information can sit beautifully on a shelf.
The Coffee Ritual can live beside the coffee machine.
The Sleep Menu can sit on a bedside table.
And the Check-Out card can appear by the door when it is actually relevant.
The information becomes part of the experience instead of visual clutter.

ONE COLLECTION. FOUR LAYOUTS.
22 signature cards come in four coordinated layouts each:
Band · Header · Full · Frame
Choose the layout that suits your space, then keep the same format throughout the property for a polished, consistent look. The files are designed to be personalised, then printed at A5 or framed at A4 depending on placement.
You get options because every interior is different.
But the system is deliberately built around consistency, not mixing everything together.

FOUR REFINED COLOURWAYS
Choose the palette that belongs in your property:
COFFEE — deep, warm and quietly sophisticated
MOSS — soft, natural and understated
OLIVE — earthy, elegant and calm
TERRACOTTA — warm, sun-washed and welcoming
The included Placement Guide specifically recommends choosing one colourway and one layout for the whole home so the result feels intentional rather than pieced together.

CARDS FOR THE QUESTIONS GUESTS ACTUALLY HAVE
The collection covers practical information throughout the stay:
Welcome Home · Wi-Fi · Check-Out · House Guidelines · Important Contacts · Waste & Recycling · Parking · Shoes Off, Slippers On · Quiet Hours · A Smoke-Free Home · Your Towels · The Guest Pantry · The Bed Is Yours · If Something's Not Right · The First Evening · The Coffee Ritual · Golden Hour · The Sleep Menu · A Rainy Day · The Story of This Place · Share the Love · The Digital Guidebook (QR)
Plus: Getting In (lockbox), 4 appliance cards (Washing Machine, Heating & Cooling, TV & Streaming, Coffee Maker) and 2 team cards for your cleaners (Cleaning Standard, Restock List).
29 cards in total.
The important thing is that these are not generic labels.
They are already thoughtfully written, with dotted fields for your own details — so you are editing useful hospitality copy rather than staring at another blank Canva template.

THE DIFFERENCE IS IN THE WRITING.
A guest card should answer the question quickly.
But the way it answers matters.
Compare:
QUIET HOURS: 10 PM–7 AM.
with:
"Sleep is the best amenity we offer. Help us protect it — for you, and for the neighbours who live here all year."
Same information.
Completely different feeling.
Or a standard towel note versus:
"The dark one? Make-up friendly. Use it guilt-free."
It solves a practical problem while still sounding like someone thought about the guest.
That is the idea behind the whole collection.
Information can be clear without being cold.

SOME CARDS GUIDE. OTHERS CREATE A MOMENT.
Not every card exists because a guest has a problem.
Some exist because good hospitality notices opportunities.
THE COFFEE RITUAL — Tell guests where the coffee is — and point them toward the best seat in the house for a slow morning.
GOLDEN HOUR — Tell them when and where the light in your property turns beautiful.
THE SLEEP MENU — Show them the pillow options, blackout setup, lighter duvet or white noise.
A RAINY DAY — Give them a Plan B before bad weather becomes disappointment.
These are small additions.
But they can change the property from somewhere to sleep into somewhere that feels hosted.

AND YES — THERE IS A RIGHT WAY TO USE THEM.
This collection includes what may be its most important part:
THE PLACEMENT GUIDE
Because giving you beautiful cards and then encouraging you to put twenty of them on the walls would defeat the entire point.
The core rule is simple:
ONE VISIBLE CARD PER ROOM. MAXIMUM.
Everything else belongs:
in the Welcome Book,
inside a useful drawer,
or directly beside the thing it explains.
The guide tells you exactly where different cards belong — from the entryway and kitchen to the bedroom, bathroom and check-out area.
This is what makes the collection feel much more like a designed hospitality system than a bundle of printable signs.

FROM "SIGN" TO STYLING OBJECT.
The Placement Guide also covers:
recommended print sizes · paper finish · frame profiles · frame materials · hanging height · standing vs. hanging placement · visual consistency
For example, it recommends A5 for shelves and consoles, A4 primarily for the entry welcome card, matte 200–250 gsm paper, thin frames coordinated with the property's existing finishes, and a gallery-standard 152 cm centre height for hung cards.
Because there is a huge visual difference between:
a sign someone printed
and
a small object that looks like it belongs in the room.

THE BOUTIQUE-HOTEL TEST.
Before a card goes anywhere, the included final check asks five questions, including:
Is there already another visible card in this room?
Is it within arm's reach of the thing it explains?
Would a boutique hotel display this — or hide it in a drawer?
Does the frame belong with the finishes in the room?
Would this card make a photograph of the corner better or worse?
That one little test says a lot about what this collection is trying to do.
Inform the guest without compromising the interior.

EDIT. PRINT. PLACE. DONE.
The process is intentionally simple.
01 · CHOOSE YOUR COLOURWAY — Coffee, Moss, Olive or Terracotta.
02 · CHOOSE YOUR LAYOUT — Band, Header, Full or Frame — and keep it consistent.
03 · MAKE IT YOURS — Replace the editable details with your own Wi-Fi, parking, check-out times, contact information and recommendations.
04 · PRINT OR FRAME — Use the included guidance to choose the right size and finish.
05 · PLACE WITH INTENTION — Follow the Placement Guide so every card earns its spot.
Then stop.
No wall of instructions required.

WHAT YOU RECEIVE

✦ 29 cards — 22 of them in four layouts: Band · Header · Full · Frame
✦ Print at A5 or frame at A4
✦ The Placement Guide — print-ready PDF in A4 and US Letter (4 pages)
✦ Professionally written hospitality copy
✦ Wi-Fi card
✦ Welcome card
✦ Check-out card
✦ House Guidelines
✦ Important Contacts
✦ Parking information
✦ Waste & Recycling
✦ Quiet Hours
✦ Smoke-Free Home
✦ Towels & bathroom guidance
✦ Guest Pantry
✦ Bedroom & sleep guidance
✦ Coffee Ritual
✦ First Evening recommendations
✦ Golden Hour
✦ Rainy Day ideas
✦ Review / QR card
✦ Digital Guidebook QR card
✦ Getting In (lockbox) card
✦ 4 appliance cards
✦ 2 team cards for your cleaners
✦ Printing, framing & styling guidance
Digital product — no physical item or frame will be shipped.

PERFECT FOR
— Airbnb hosts
— Vacation rental owners
— Short-term rental hosts
— VRBO properties

— Guest houses
— Property managers
— Interior-conscious hosts
— Hosts who want clearer guest communication without covering their property in instructions

THIS COLLECTION IS FOR YOU IF…
— you keep leaving handwritten notes around the property.
— your guests repeatedly ask where something is.
— you need house rules but hate the way "house rules signs" look.
— you want your Wi-Fi information accessible without sticking a password to the fridge.
— you want practical communication to feel consistent with the rest of your interior.
— you care just as much about how something is said as what it says.
And especially if you have ever thought:
"I need guests to know this. I just don't want an ugly sign saying it."
That is exactly what these cards were created for.

CLEAR ENOUGH TO GUIDE.
BEAUTIFUL ENOUGH TO BELONG.
The best guest communication does not shout.

WHERE CAN I FIND MORE ANSWERS AND TUTORIALS?
Visit my FAQ Help Center, where I've gathered answers to the most common questions, with step-by-step guides:
👉 sites.google.com/view/templates4brandinghelpcenter/home
If you don't find your answer, message me on Etsy. I'll be happy to help 😊

DO I NEED CANVA PRO TO EDIT MY INVITATION?
No! All my templates work with a free Canva account. You can edit on a computer, phone or tablet.

HOW DO I DOWNLOAD MY TEMPLATE?
After purchase, log into Etsy from a web browser (the download button doesn't appear in the Etsy app), go to "Your account" › "Purchases and reviews" and click "Download Files". Open the PDF and click the Canva link inside to start editing.

CAN I EDIT THE INVITATION IN SPANISH OR ANOTHER LANGUAGE?
Yes! Every word is editable, so you can write your invitation in English, Spanish or any language, or make it bilingual.

CAN YOU EDIT THE INVITATION FOR ME?
Of course! For small changes, just message me. For a done-for-you invitation, I offer a Full Editing Service (48h), available in my shop under "Add-Ons & Edits".

CAN YOU MAKE MY CUSTOM THEME OR CUSTOM COLORS INVITATION?
Please contact me before purchasing and send me your inspiration, color palette, and the template you would like me to customize. I’ll send you a first preview, and if you love it, you can then purchase the matching editing service from my shop under “Add-Ons & Edits.”

WHAT IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A VIDEO INVITATION AND A WEBSITE INVITATION?
Both options are digital and can be sent by email, text message, WhatsApp, or social media.

✔ A video invitation is an MP4 file with music, animations, photos, and a QR code for RSVP. The video and music play automatically when your guests open or play the file. It is beautiful and easy to share, but it does not include clickable buttons or interactive sections.

✔ A website invitation is a scrollable interactive Canva website link. It can include clickable RSVP, Google Maps, countdown, gift registry, schedule, photo gallery, FAQ, and other interactive features. Please note that music on a website invitation is click-to-play only and cannot autoplay.

HOW DO MY GUESTS RSVP?
It depends on your invitation type:

🌐 Website invitation: guests fill in the embedded form or tap the RSVP button right on your invitation.
🎬 Video invitation: guests scan the QR code in the video.

Either way, they RSVP in one click, with no app or account needed. You can choose the RSVP option you prefer:
✔ Google Form: see every response in real time and receive email notifications
✔ A Canva Form
✔ Your own RSVP link, such as Zola, The Knot, Joy or any wedding website you already use

Don't need an RSVP? No problem! Everything is fully editable, so you can easily delete the RSVP button, section or page from your template.

CAN I GET A REFUND OR EXCHANGE?
Returns aren't accepted for digital downloads. However, if you purchased the wrong color or design by mistake, just message me and I'll be happy to exchange it for the one you wanted. And if anything goes wrong with your file, I'll gladly help until everything works perfectly 😊

results.description:
Convierte a todo tu equipo en embajadores de hospitalidad 5 estrellas con un PDF de descarga instantánea y diseño impecable.

La mayoría de los anfitriones se obsesionan con el espacio: las sábanas, la iluminación, la estación de café perfectamente estilizada. Y eso importa. Pero los mejores anfitriones saben una verdad silenciosa: la *sensación* es lo que genera reseñas brillantes, reservas repetidas y la posibilidad de cobrar tarifas premium.

Este no es un libro de bienvenida genérico. Es una guía de entrenamiento en comunicación y comportamiento para ti, tu coanfitrión, tu equipo de limpieza y cualquiera que lleve tu marca. Les da a todos las palabras, acciones y mentalidad exactas para que cada huésped se sienta genuinamente bienvenido, profundamente valorado y completamente cuidado — desde el primer mensaje hasta la despedida final.

---

QUÉ INCLUYE EL PDF DE 25 PÁGINAS

📘 Los 4 Secretos de la Llegada Mágica
La secuencia exacta de los primeros 30 segundos que define el tono emocional de toda la estancia. Entrena a tu equipo para aplicar Sonrisa, Postura, Ver y Simple & Específico de forma natural.

🗣️ Guiones de Saludos y Despedidas
Plantillas listas para copiar en mensajes, llamadas y bienvenidas en persona. Cubre prellegada, durante la estancia, salida, huéspedes que regresan, llegadas tarde y agradecimientos post-reseña. Sin necesidad de improvisar.

🛡️ Método L.A.S.T. para Quejas
Un marco paso a paso para manejar problemas sin pánico: Escuchar, Disculparse, Solucionar, Agradecer. Convierte una situación de 3 estrellas en una recuperación de 5 que genera más lealtad que una estancia perfecta.

✅ La Hoja Azul: 10 Reglas de Comportamiento No Negociables
El código cultural esencial del equipo. Cubre uso del teléfono, límites con huéspedes, normas sobre olores y comida, orgullo por la propiedad y la ceremonia de cierre "últimos oídos afuera". Imprímela, fíjala y hazla tu estándar.

🗓️ Ritmo de Comunicación de 5 Mensajes
Una cronología completa de mensajes que encantan al huésped: reserva instantánea → 3 días antes → noche 1 → mañana de salida → post-reseña. Lista para copiar en tu sistema automatizado o enviar manualmente.

🎁 BONO: Frases para Crisis y Tarjeta de Referencia Rápida
Guiones de bolsillo para plagas, cortes de luz, errores de reserva, quejas por ruido y cierres de puerta. Además, una tarjeta resumen de una página para imprimir y compartir.

A: Sie wählen bis zu 5 Sprachen (einfach im Intake-Formular angeben) - wir richten alle ein. Gäste lesen es, und die KI antwortet in ihrer eigenen Sprache.

F: Können wir es in Zukunft aktualisieren?

F: Funktioniert es für Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking und Direktbuchungen?
A: Ja - es ist nur ein Link, also funktioniert es überall, wo Ihr Gast gebucht hat.

F: Ich habe mehrere Unterkünfte - geht das auch?
A: Ja. Jede Unterkunft bekommt ihr eigenes Buch; nahezu identische Einheiten im selben Gebäude erhalten einen vergünstigten Preis. Schreiben Sie uns einfach.

F: Kann ich eine echte Demo sehen, bevor ich kaufe?
A: Ja - scannen Sie den QR-Code auf dem ersten Foto (oder schreiben Sie uns), um eine echte, funktionierende Demo zu öffnen. Keine Anmeldung.
